lines.zh: 最终的形状，走起来很轻。
lines.en: Final form. I walk light on my feet.

lines.zh: 地面没有一丝多余的响动。
lines.en: The ground makes no wasted sound.
I walk as if taking a stroll.
Thinner now, and steadier.
My tail traces an arc.
I do not watch the path. The path yields.
One step, two, unhurried.
My cloak lies flat; even the wind is quiet.

lines.zh: 地上没有印记，我却到了。
lines.en: No prints, yet I have arrived.
I pass a tree, and it snaps first.

lines.zh: 走得很慢，是为了让你看清楚。
lines.en: Slow, so you can watch properly.
On the last step I stop at the door.
Standing, my aura drawn in tight.

lines.zh: 这具身体，才是真正的我。
lines.en: This body is the real me.
A wisp of ki circles my fingertip.

lines.zh: 我看一眼天空，云就散了。
lines.en: I glance at the sky, and the clouds part.
I am deciding how much force to use.
When I smile, my eyes do not.
One breath lifts the dust.
This quiet is almost improper.

lines.zh: 这星球的重力，几乎不存在。
lines.en: This world's gravity barely exists.
Just standing bends the grass.
No one left worth transforming for.
I am waiting for one exchange.
Now I truly look at you.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，你的气就散了。
lines.en: In this form, your ki simply scatters.
Do not be afraid. It ends soon.
You had strength a second ago.

lines.zh: 这双眼睛看清你每一处。
lines.en: These eyes see every part of you.
Your feet move backward.

lines.zh: 我只是看着，你就喘不上气。
lines.en: I only look, and you cannot breathe.
Did you remember my name?
This close, and you dare not move.

lines.zh: 你这身甲，挡不住一根手指。
lines.en: Your armor cannot stop one finger.

lines.zh: 我允许你说最后一句话。
lines.en: You may say one last thing.

lines.zh: 你的气在抖，像风里的火。
lines.en: Your ki flickers like a flame in wind.
I admire that you have not run.
Even looking up costs you effort.
I count your heartbeats. Fast.
Look at me once more, then decide.
A pity. You have no chance.
You touched my body.
This small pain is real.
I stepped back. That is rare.
A tear in my hem.
Blood? I am rather surprised.
Your hand shakes. I can tell.
That changed things.
Good. You have my attention.
I am not hurt. I am angry.
You will pay this price.
You dare offer this?
Food does not interest me.
I know exactly what you want.
Your life would be a fair trade.

lines.zh: 越珍贵的东西，越像陷阱。
lines.en: The rarer the thing, the more it smells of a trap.
Put it down and step back.
Dragon Balls? Worth a look.
That works on others.
I do not need it. I want it.
You shake so much you can barely hold it.
I stood still. You collided.

lines.zh: 这点冲力，连披风都没动。
lines.en: That did not even stir my cloak.
Back off. I dislike dirtying my hands.
You tremble, yet you push forward.
Clear the way. Do not block.
My shoulder brushed you.

lines.zh: 你被弹开的样子，有点难看。
lines.en: Your bounce looks undignified.
Do not touch my tail.
Stand up. Do not lean on me.
One more step and you are gone.

lines.zh: 这是我最不需要的东西。
lines.en: The thing I need least.
Beyond power, I ask nothing.
This body belongs to combat alone.
Say no more of it.
What you want, I cannot give.
I do not even love myself.
This is utterly dull.
Put your hand down.
My patience ends here.
Utterly absurd.
A stone, and I am to pick it up?
One finger, and it comes to me.
Let me see what this is.
It fits my hand.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，都是无主之物。
lines.en: Fallen things have no owner.
So light I feel nothing.
I toss it away at once.
This one I keep.
Bending is a nuisance.
Your possession is now mine.
You are today's opponent?
Your ki is locked.
One finger is all I need.
Death Ball. Begin.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see exactly where you stand.
Do not run. It wastes time.
I will take this one a little seriously.
This is the last one.
Good. You still stand.
One look is enough.
Beam, ready.
I need not come close.
This exchange ends here.
I will not bother with your name.
The target is chosen.
Come. Do not dawdle.
A point of light at my fingertip, aimed at you.
It takes no time to aim.
Wherever you hide, I see.
This range is far too close for you.
My toes hover half an inch off the ground.
The Death Ball spins in my palm.
The air begins to sink.
His breathing grows ragged.
No hurry. Time favors me.

lines.zh: 这星球上没有第二个选择。
lines.en: No second option exists on this world.
He shifts left, and my aim follows.
I strike the moment he settles.
This ki is pitifully weak.
Chin raised, I look down.
One second passes. Two.
There is no need to wait further.
You have no retreat left.
Good. Stay just like that.
One finger pierces his armor.
The beam cuts straight through.
The Death Ball leaves my hand.
Aerial combo. Three hits.

lines.zh: 我推他的胸口，他飞出去。
lines.en: A palm to his chest, and he flies.
A kick to the knee.

lines.zh: 他连我的衣角都没碰到。
lines.en: He never touched my hem.
The punch lands lightly.
My tail takes him down.
Blasts rain down.
He is pressed into the dirt.
Dust only settles after I stop.
No need to follow that one up.

lines.zh: 我看他还能不能站起来。
lines.en: Let us see if he can stand.
A clean strike.
This is where it ends.
Final form. I have come.

lines.zh: 这一次，我不再压制力量。
lines.en: This time I hold nothing back.

lines.zh: 一亿两千万，够清楚了吗？
lines.en: One hundred twenty million. Clear enough?
No one need welcome me.
Drop those ridiculous expressions.
This body is my answer.

lines.zh: 落地时连尘土都不敢扬。
lines.en: Even the dust dares not rise.
I look around. No opponents.
From here, the rules are rewritten.
I will pay your god a visit.
I will not play long this time.
Your time is up.
Quiet. Let me finish.
I came to end this.
Those still standing may still kneel.
The clock starts now.
Flame touches my skin but does not enter.

lines.zh: 落地时，我的膝盖弯了一下。
lines.en: On landing, my knee bent once.
Water in my mouth and nose. Unpleasant.
The blast threw my cloak open.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我胸前，然后掉下去。
lines.en: An arrow stuck in my chest, then fell.
This power is genuinely rare.
Even this body must eat.
Current passes through; my fingers tingle.
The void's pull is not to be dismissed.
